name: Causton Street Play Area
text: On the Millbank Estate behind Tate Britain: a play area for 3 to 7 year olds and a multi-use games area for older children. Step-free access; no dogs.

name: Drury Lane Gardens Playground
text: A pocket park in Theatreland with a raised play area, a multi-sport court and a quiet seating area.

name: Edbrooke Road Playground
text: A small local park with a small play area, mainly for younger children. Step-free access.

name: Lisson Street Gardens Playground
text: A sunken community garden with a play area at one end and a small amphitheatre at the other. Step-free access; no dogs.

name: Paddington Street Gardens Playground
text: Formal gardens with a bandstand and a children's play area. Step-free access, with toilets (including accessible ones) reached from Paddington Street.

name: Porchester Square Gardens Playground
text: A traditional London square with lawns, flower beds and a children's play area. Step-free access.

name: Queen's Park Gardens Playground
text: A park with a playground, a free multi-use ball court, a wildlife garden, a dog run and seating. Step-free access.

name: St John's Wood Church Grounds Playground
text: Former church grounds north of Regent's Park with a refurbished playground, formal gardens and a nature reserve area. Step-free access, with an accessible toilet on site.

name: St Stephen's Gardens Playground
text: A small public garden with a play area, seating and a pergola. Step-free access; no dogs.

name: Tamplin Mews Gardens Playground
text: A small pocket park with a playground for small children in one corner. Step-free access.

name: Violet Hill Gardens Playground
text: A small traditional garden with a good playground surrounded by flower borders. Step-free access, with an accessible toilet on site.

name: Westbourne Green Playground
text: A large open green space with trees, wildflower areas and a playground.
